attempts.response: {"version":1,"board":"arduino:avr:uno","control_period_ms":10,"interface_requests":[{"kind":"digital_input","pin":"D2","initial":false,"meaning":"Button increment; pressed => true; used to add 1 unless out of range"},{"kind":"digital_input","pin":"D3","initial":false,"meaning":"Button decrement; pressed => true; used to subtract 1 unless out of range"},{"kind":"tone_output","pin":"D6","initial":0,"meaning":"Buzzer alarm when counter reaches upper limit 20 or lower limit 0; silence otherwise"},{"kind":"tm1637_number","clk_pin":"D4","dio_pin":"D5","initial":0,"meaning":"TM1637 real-time display of counter value (0..20); out-of-range requests blanked"}],"serial_channels":[],"planning_notes":["Board: arduino:avr:uno.","Wiring is exactly preserved: D2 increment button, D3 decrement button, TM1637 CLK=D4 and DIO=D5, buzzer on D6.","Button inputs are modeled as active-high at the model level: io_i=true means pressed (no additional inversion in the model).","Counter initial value is not explicitly specified in the requirements; tm1637_number initial is set to 0 to match the lower bound and allow immediate correct display.","Buzzer behavior (alarm tones and 'no further越界动作') is handled in SysML; this proposal only defines the I/O ports, not timers/threshold logic.","No serial requirements were provided; therefore no serial_channels are configured."]}

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个多功能计数与显示系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于加一计数，D3 用于减一计数，数码管实时显示计数值；当计数达到上限 20 或下限 0 时蜂鸣器报警，并禁止继续越界。
